blocks.html: In addition to requirements of Section 1008, safe areas shall be artificially lighted by electrical means at all times during occupancy of a place of assembly so as to provide illumination of at least 5 footcandles (54 lux) at the level of the floor and on the surface of all stairs, steps, ramps, and escalators within the safe area.
